title: 第3章 看走眼啦
content_zh:
这时，岳胜慢慢站起，伸了个懒腰，走到货车旁边检查，忽然叫道：“小兵，你过来。瞧瞧这里怎么了。”周银兵听干爸喊他，忙起身过去。岳胜侧过身子，面向墙壁，伸手整理着货物，低声说：“不长进的东西，你那招‘垫步踹腿’怎么踹偏了？否则哪用得着跟他缠斗这么久？”周银兵吓了一跳，颤声说：“您……您都瞧见啦？”岳胜说：“你别想在我面前捣鬼。他使那招‘提步高探马’时，你干嘛不使‘弓步双推掌’反击？迎面直击，早就赢啦。你就是胆小怕死。”周银兵回想刚才相斗时，开始不知敌人虚实，果然有些害怕，有几招使得太过稳重。看来干爸是装作不知，其实场上一切早已尽收眼底。

    岳胜又说：“快进去谢谢那位姓温的少堡主吧。人家年纪虽然比你轻，可有多精明能干。”周银兵大为诧异，叫道：“谢他什么？这姓温的偏心，不是好人！”岳胜冷笑说：“是呀，他是偏心啊。可是他偏心维护的是你周大爷呐。”周银兵满心糊涂，怔怔望着干爸。岳胜低声说：“你打的是什么人？他是警官。咱们是什么人？那是靠人家赏口饭吃的跑腿运货的。警官当真跟你为难起来，咱们还不是吃不了兜着走？那位少堡主保住了他的面子，叫你这愣小子少了桩后患啊！”

    周银兵恍然大悟，连称：“是！是！”奔到后院练武厅中，只见温文新抬手踢腿，在练查拳中的一招“弓步劈打”，正是周银兵刚才用以击中田星辰的那招。他见周银兵进来，脸上一红，急忙收拳。

    周银兵抱拳说：“少堡主，我干爸叫我跟你道谢来啦。我起初不明白你是好意，心里还怪你呢。”温文新说：“周大哥，你武功胜过那警员何止十倍？小弟佩服得紧。”周银兵听他称赞自己，甚是高兴，当即跟他谈了起来，问道：“你练的是哪一门功夫？”温文新说：“小弟初学，什么也没学会，谈不上是哪门哪派。适才见周大哥用这招打他，是不是这样？”说着右足踏出，右拳劈打，左手心向上托住右臂。

    周银兵刚才以此招取胜，见他比划自己的得意之作，自然兴高采烈，说道：“这招有两句口诀，叫作‘陆海迎门三不顾，劈拳挑打不容宽。’”这两句顺口说出，忽然想起这是家门心法，怎能胡乱说给外人听？忙转口说：“你比划得很对，就是这样的。”

    温文新问：“什么叫作‘陆海迎门三不顾’呢？”周银兵说：“这个……这个我可也忘啦。”他不善撒谎，这句话出口，脸也红了。温文新知他不肯说，也就不再多问，只着意结纳，将他捧得晕头转向，全身轻飘飘的如在云端。

    周银兵说：“温老弟，咱们也别闹虚文。你使套拳脚给我瞧瞧，倘若有什么不到的地方，我跟你说说，也不枉了今日结交一场。”温文新大喜，说道：“那再好也没有了。”当下拉开架子，在场中打起拳来，但见他“头趟绳挂一条鞭，二趟十字绕三尖”，使的是十二路潭腿。

    这路拳脚使得倒也纯熟，但出拳不正，脚步浮虚，虽然袍袖生风，姿势华丽，若与人动手，却半点不管用。只把周银兵看得暗暗摇头，等他打完“十二趟犀牛望月转回还”，忍不住叹了口气说：“温老弟，莫怪我直言，教你武艺的师父是耽误了你啦。”正要往下解释，忽见岳青在厅门口一探头说：“哥，爸爸叫你。”

    周银兵忙向温文新告辞，回到厅上。只见火堆旁又多了两个避雨的人。一个是中年乞丐，一条极长的刀疤从右眉起斜过鼻子，一直延伸到左边嘴角，在火光照耀下显得面目可怖。另一个是十二三岁的男孩，衣衫褴褛，一张脸脏兮兮的，但是双目炯炯有神。

    周银兵向两人望了一眼，也不在意，走到岳胜面前，叫了声：“干爸！”岳胜脸一沉，低声说：“去了这么久，又去卖弄武艺了，是不是？”周银兵说：“啊……没有。这里姓温的主人暗器打的不错，哪知拳脚功夫一点也不成，”岳胜说：“傻小子，你又看走眼啦。凭你这点功夫，就有两个也不是人家的对手！”周银兵嗤的一笑说：“那也不见得。他师父教的十二路潭腿，尽是好看不管用。”岳胜问：“你知他师父是谁？”

    周银兵心中暗奇：“干爸没跟那姓温的见过面，又没见他练过拳脚，怎么连他师父是谁也知道了？”当下回答：“不知道，想来是个不中用的江湖骗子。”岳胜冷笑一声，低沉着声音说：“不中用的江湖骗子！嘿嘿，十三年前，你干爸给人砍过一刀、劈过一掌，养了三年伤才康复。那人是谁？”周银兵一惊，说道：“紫金刀客温宏伟！”岳胜低声说：“半点也不错。温宏伟家住山东武定，是万澜物流集团厉总的开山大弟子。这里可正是武定县，主人家姓温。咱们胡乱进来避雨，初时并没留心。你瞧，正梁上绘着什么？”

    周银兵抬起头来，只见正梁上金灿灿写着“万丈狂澜”四个大字，那正是万澜物流集团的口号，不由大吃一惊，忙说：“干爸，快抄家伙！咱们撞到仇家窝里来啦。”岳胜淡淡说：“倒也不用忙，温宏伟早给人杀啦。”

    周银兵曾听干爸说过当年大败在一人手里，那就是温宏伟。只因这是家门奇耻大辱，干爸后来不提，也就不敢多问，却不知温宏伟原来已死。

    周银兵低声问：“是您老人家后来报了仇吗？”岳胜哼了声说：“温宏伟的武功，我再练十年也赶不上。凭我这点玩意，哪能杀得了他？”周银兵大奇，问道：“那么是谁杀了他？”岳胜说：“那位少堡主用金钱镖打木牌上的人形，温宏伟就是给这两人杀的。”

    周银兵睁大了眼睛说：“闵恩仇！秦英豪！”

    岳胜点了点头，脸上神色阴郁，就像屋外的天空那般黑沉沉的。

    周银兵平素对干爸佩服得五体投地，以为当世说到武功，极少有人能强过他了。岂知这时听干爸言语，不但温宏伟的武功远胜于他，而闵恩仇、秦英豪这二人的功夫又在温宏伟之上，不由大为惊诧。低声问：“那闵恩仇、秦英豪是何等样人物？”岳胜说：“闵恩仇武功胜我十倍。只可惜在十多年前就死了。”周银兵舒了口气问：“是病死的吗？”岳胜说：“给人杀死的。”周银兵睁大了眼睛问：“他……他这么厉害，谁能杀得了他？”岳胜说：“射阳名侠秦英豪。”

    “射阳名侠秦英豪”七字一出口，声音虽低，却大具威严。周银兵胸口一沉，正要说话，猛听门外隐隐传来马蹄声响，大雨中十数匹马急奔而来。那男子与那美妇听到马蹄声，互望一眼，似在强自镇定，但脸上终究露出了惊惶之色。那男子拉着美妇的手，挪动座位，似怕火堆炙热，移远了些。岳胜向外望了一眼，紧了紧腰带。十多匹马奔到堡前，戛然而止。但听数声唿哨，七八匹马绕到了堡后。

    岳胜一听哨声，脸上变色，低声说：“定着点儿。”周银兵却极是兴奋，声音发颤，问道：“那话儿来了？”岳胜不再回答，大声喝道：“大伙抄家伙，护住货物！”这句话一喝，海安众人顿时大乱，知道有劫货的黑道强人到来，当即跃起。司机将十余辆货车围成一堆。岳青反而脸有喜色，拔出柳叶刀问：“爸爸，是哪一路的？”岳胜皱眉说：“还不知道。”接着自言自语：“这路朋友好怪，道上也不踩盘子，就这么说到便到。”

    一言方罢，只听围墙上托托托接连声响，八名大汉一色黑衣打扮，手执武器，一字排开站在墙头。岳青扬起右臂，就想一枝袖箭射出。岳胜脸色凝重，低声喝道：“别胡来！瞧我眼色行事。”八名黑衣大汉望着厅上众人，一言不发。

    砰的一声，大门推开，进来一个汉子，身穿宝蓝色风衣，衣服甚是华丽，但面貌猥琐，缩头缩脑，与一身衣服极不相称。这人抬头望了望天，见大雨倾盆而下，嘿嘿一笑，足尖一点，倏地穿过院子，站在厅口。这下飞跃身形快极，大雨虽密，却只在他肩头打湿了数点。周银兵与岳青对此人本来不以为意，突然见他露了这手轻功，这才生忌惮之心，向岳胜望了一眼。

    岳胜拱手说：“请恕老汉眼拙，没曾拜会。朋友尊姓大名，宝寨歇马哪里？”

    温文新听到马蹄声，当即暗藏金钱镖，腰悬利刃，来到厅前。见那盗魁手戴碧玉扳指，风衣上闪耀着几粒黄金扣子，左手拿着个翡翠鼻烟壶，不带武器，神情打扮，就如是个土豪暴发户。只听他说：“在下曹虎，老板自是海安物流的岳老板了？”

    岳胜抱拳说：“不敢，这外号是江湖朋友给在下脸上贴金。三脚猫的把式，浪得虚名，不足挂齿。”心中暗忖：“曹虎？那是什么人？没听说江湖上有这号人物。”
content_en:
At this time, Yue Sheng stood up slowly, stretched, walked to the truck to check, and suddenly shouted: "Xiao Bing, come here. See what's going on here." Zhou Yinbing heard his godfather calling him and hurriedly got up and went over.Yue Sheng turned sideways, faced the wall, stretched out his hands to arrange the goods, and whispered: "Things that are not growing, why did you miss the step with your 'step kick'? Otherwise, why would you have fought with him for so long?" Zhou Yinbing was startled and said in a trembling voice: "You...you saw it all?" Yue Sheng said: "Don'tYou want to make trouble in front of me.When he used the move of "Hitting the Horse with High Steps", why didn't you use the "Lung Step and Double Push Palm" to fight back?You would have won a long time ago.You are just timid and afraid of death." Zhou Yinbing recalled that he didn't know the strength of the enemy at first, and he was really a little too cautious with some of his moves.It seems that the godfather is pretending not to know, but in fact, everything on the scene has already been seen.
Yue Sheng said again: "Go in quickly and thank the young castle master named Wen. Although he is younger than you, he is very smart and capable." Zhou Yinbing was greatly surprised and shouted: "Why are you thanking him? This man named Wen is partial, not a good person!" Yue Sheng sneered and said, "Yes, he is partial. But it is you, Uncle Zhou, who he is partial to protect." Zhou Yinbing was confused and stared at his godfather.Yue Sheng said in a low voice: "Who are you beating? He is a police officer. Who are we? We are errands and goods transported by others for food. If the police officer really makes things difficult for you, why don't we just walk around without food? The young fort master saved his face and saved this stupid boy like you from future troubles!"
Zhou Yinbing suddenly realized and said: "Yes! Yes!" He ran to the martial arts training hall in the backyard and saw Wen Wenxin raising his hands and kicking his legs. The "Lunge Split" move he was practicing in Zhaquan was exactly the move Zhou Yinbing used to hit Tian Xingchen just now.When he saw Zhou Yinbing come in, his face turned red and he quickly closed his fist.
Zhou Yinbing clasped his fists and said, "Young Master, my godfather asked me to come and say thank you. I didn't understand your good intentions at first, and I blamed you in my heart." Wen Wenxin said, "Brother Zhou, your martial arts is ten times better than that of the policeman? I admire you very much." Zhou Yinbing was very happy when he heard him praise him.Wen Wenxin started talking to him and asked, "Which Kung Fu do you practice?" Wen Wenxin said, "I'm a newbie and haven't learned anything. I can't tell which sect I belong to. I just saw Brother Zhou hitting him with this move. Is it like this?" As he spoke, he stepped out with his right foot, struck with his right fist, and raised his left hand to support his right arm.
Zhou Yinbing won with this move just now. When he saw him gesturing his proud work, he was naturally very happy and said: "There are two formulas for this move, which are called 'Lu Hai welcomes the door without paying any attention, and does not show mercy when he picks and punches.'" After saying these two sentences smoothly, he suddenly remembered that this is a family secret. How could he tell outsiders carelessly?He quickly turned around and said, "You made the right gesture, that's it."
Wen Wenxin asked: "What do you mean by 'ignoring the door to welcome Lu Hai'?" Zhou Yinbing said: "This...I have forgotten this." He was not good at lying, and his face turned red when he said this.Wen Wenxin knew that he refused to say anything, so he stopped asking any more questions and just focused on accepting him. He held him so dizzy that his whole body felt as light as floating in the clouds.
Zhou Yinbing said: "Brother Wen, let's not make a fuss. Show me how you use your fists and kicks. If there is anything you can't do, I'll tell you. Today's friendship is not in vain." Wen Wenxin was overjoyed and said, "That's not the best." He then opened his airs and started fisting in the field, but saw that he "hangs a whip on the first rope, and wraps the cross around the three points with the second trip", using the twelve-way leg.
He is quite proficient in this way of boxing and kicking, but his punches are not correct and his steps are sloppy. Although his sleeves are windy and his posture is gorgeous, if he fights with others, it will not work at all.Zhou Yinbing only looked at Zhou Yinbing and shook his head secretly. After he finished the "Twelve Times of Rhino Watching the Moon and Returning", he couldn't help but sigh and said: "Brother Wen, don't blame me for bluntly saying that the master who taught you martial arts has delayed you." Just as he was about to explain, he suddenly saw Yue Qing peeking his head at the door of the hall and said: "Brother, dad is calling you."
Zhou Yinbing hurriedly said goodbye to Wen Wenxin and returned to the hall.I saw two more people taking shelter by the fire.One was a middle-aged beggar, with a very long scar running from his right eyebrow across his nose to the left corner of his mouth. His face looked terrifying under the firelight.The other was a boy of twelve or thirteen years old, with ragged clothes and a dirty face, but his eyes were bright.
Zhou Yinbing glanced at the two of them without paying attention. He walked up to Yue Sheng and called out: "Godfather!" Yue Sheng's face sank and he whispered: "You've been here for so long and you're showing off your martial arts again, right?" Zhou Yinbing said: "Ah... no. The owner surnamed Wen here is good at concealed weapons, but he's not very good at boxing or kicking.Not at all." Yue Sheng said, "You fool, you are wrong again.With your little skill, there are two people who are no match for me!" Zhou Yinbing sneered and said, "That's not true.The twelve-step Tan Kung Fu taught by his master is very good but not effective." Yue Sheng asked, "Do you know who his master is?"
Zhou Yinbing secretly wondered: "My godfather has never met the man named Wen, and I have never seen him practice boxing. How come he knows who his master is?" He immediately replied: "I don't know, I guess he is a worthless charlatan." Yue Sheng sneered and said in a low voice: "A worthless charlatan! Hehe, thirteen years ago, your godfather chopped a knife and slapped someone in the face.It took three years for him to recover.Who is that person?" Zhou Yinbing was shocked and said: "It's not bad at all.Wen Hongwei lives in Wuding, Shandong, and is the founder of Wanlan Logistics Group.The owner's surname is Wen.Look, what was painted on the main beam at first?"
Zhou Yinbing raised his head and saw the four characters "Ten Thousand Zhang Raging Waves" written in gold on the main beam. That was the slogan of Wanlan Logistics Group. He couldn't help but was shocked and said hurriedly: "Dad, hurry up! We have bumped into the enemy's nest." Yue Sheng said calmly: "There is no need to be busy, Wen Hongwei has been killed long ago."
Zhou Yinbing once heard his godfather say that the defeat was at the hands of one person, and that was Wen Hongwei.Because this was a great disgrace to the family, his godfather didn't mention it later, so he didn't dare to ask more questions, but he didn't know that Wen Hongwei was dead.
Zhou Yinbing asked in a low voice: "Did you take revenge later?" Yue Sheng snorted and said: "I can't catch up with Wen Hongwei's martial arts for another ten years. With my little skills, how can I kill him?" Zhou Yinbing was surprised and asked: "Then who killed him?" Yue Sheng said: "The young castle master used the money dart to hit the human figure on the wooden sign. Wen Hongwei was killed by these two people."
Zhou Yinbing opened his eyes wide and said, "Min Enchou! Qin Yinghao!"
Yue Sheng nodded, with a gloomy look on his face, as dark as the sky outside the house.
Zhou Yinbing always admired his godfather and thought that when it came to martial arts, there were very few people in the world who could surpass him.Little did he know that when he heard what his godfather said, not only Wen Hongwei's martial arts was far better than his, but Min Enchou and Qin Yinghao's kung fu were also superior to Wen Hongwei's, he couldn't help but be shocked.He asked in a low voice: "What kind of people are Min Enchou and Qin Yinghao?" Yue Sheng said: "Min Enchou was ten times better than me in martial arts. It's a pity that he died more than ten years ago." Zhou Yinbing breathed a sigh of relief and asked: "Did he die of illness?" Yue Sheng said: "He was killed by others." Zhou Yinbing opened his eyes and asked: "He... he is so powerful, who can kill him?" Yue Sheng said: "Qin Yinghao, the famous knight in Sheyang."
"Qin Yinghao, the famous hero of Sheyang" was spoken in seven words. Although his voice was low, it was majestic.Zhou Yinbing's chest sank, and just as he was about to speak, he suddenly heard the faint sound of horse hoofs coming from outside the door, and dozens of horses were rushing towards him in the heavy rain.The man and the beautiful woman heard the sound of horse hooves and looked at each other, as if they were trying to calm themselves down, but after all, their faces showed panic.The man took the beautiful woman's hand and moved his seat, as if he was afraid of the heat of the fire and moved further away.Yue Sheng glanced outside and tightened his belt.More than a dozen horses rushed to the front of the fort and stopped suddenly.But after hearing several whistles, seven or eight horses came around the back of the fort.
When Yue Sheng heard the whistle, his face changed color, and he whispered: "Calm down." Zhou Yinbing was extremely excited, and his voice trembled, and asked: "What's going on?" Yue Sheng stopped answering and shouted loudly: "Everyone robs the guy, protect the goods!" As soon as he said this, everyone in Hai'an was in chaos. Knowing that the gangster strongman was about to rob the goods, they jumped up immediately.The driver gathered a dozen trucks into a pile.On the contrary, Yue Qing's face became happy, he pulled out the lancet and asked, "Dad, which road are you on?" Yue Sheng frowned and said, "I don't know yet." Then he said to himself: "My friends on this road are so weird. They don't step on the plates on the road. They just go as they say."
As soon as he said that, he heard the sound of "Toto Toto" one after another on the wall. Eight big men dressed in black, holding weapons in their hands, stood in a row on the wall.Yue Qing raised his right arm, intending to shoot a sleeve arrow.Yue Sheng's face was solemn and he shouted in a low voice: "Don't be ridiculous! Look at my eyes." The eight big men in black looked at the people in the hall without saying a word.
With a bang, the door opened, and a man came in, wearing a royal blue windbreaker. The clothes were very gorgeous, but his face was wretched and his head was shrinking, which was very inconsistent with his clothes.The man looked up at the sky and saw the heavy rain pouring down. He smiled, tiptoed, quickly crossed the yard and stood at the entrance of the hall.This leap was extremely fast. Although the heavy rain was heavy, it only wet a few spots on his shoulders.Zhou Yinbing and Yue Qing didn't take this person seriously at first, but when they suddenly saw him showing off his Qing Kung Fu, they became jealous and glanced at Yue Sheng.
Yue Sheng cupped his hands and said, "Please forgive me for my poor eyesight. I have never paid a visit to you. My friend has a distinguished name. Where can I rest my horse in Baozhai?"
When Wen Wenxin heard the sound of horse hooves, he immediately came to the front of the hall with a hidden money dart and a sharp knife hanging from his waist.I saw that the bandit leader was wearing a jasper finger ring, a few gold buttons shining on his windbreaker, and an emerald snuff bottle in his left hand. He was unarmed and dressed like a wealthy nouveau riche.Just listen to him say: "I'm Cao Hu, the boss is the boss Yue of Hai'an Logistics?"
Yue Sheng clasped his fists and said, "I don't dare. This nickname is given to me by my friends in the martial arts world. The three-legged cat's style is so unworthy that it is not worth mentioning." He thought to himself: "Cao Hu? Who is that person? I have never heard of such a person in the martial arts world."
